_comment: Stage 1.2 teacher target cache: the frozen Stage 1.1 teacher acts at 25/50 NFE in the QLM training environment on 8 streams; its own chunks (noise, video plan, action) become about 5000 regression targets. Run with `python -m wam_policy.opsd cache`; the cache is <output>/learner/cache. Its 64 task/position-stratified entries are the held-out set of every Stage 1.2 run and it is the previous cache of Stage 2.2 M-OPD.
